plan_owner_impacts.impact: First-class All Settings compendium (faceted, virtualized index over the real 828) is a candidate primary long-tail surface; facet state (category/type/status/tier + within-filter + sort) implies a route-keyed view-state contract (#/all?cat=...).

Domain pages combining overview stats + key settings + related managers propose a canonical domain-page composition; manager list/detail workspace proposes roster+detail as the default manager geometry.

Provider detail tabs (overview/models/settings/credentials/limits/diagnostics/install) with section aliases (accounts->credentials, logs->diagnostics, catalog->models, setup->overview) propose canonical ?sec= sectioning; Installation deferred insertion stays inside install tab.

settings_inventory_impacts.impact: No new inventory rows; renders the verbatim 828-row inventory (PMInventoryData). Synthetic stress +2000 rows are generated, marked Synthetic, never replace real data, and never navigate.

settings_schema_impacts.impact: Legacy scope metadata (scope: [global]) preserved for provenance but never rendered as an editable scope; project-only presentation (see plan-owner-delta.md). Facets expose category/type/tier/status as read dimensions, not scopes.

command_id_impacts.impact: See candidate-command-delta.json; all IDs provisional census reuse/alias/candidate.

dry_component_impacts.impact: See candidate-dry-delta.json; presentation-only reuse of headless modules (PMState2/PMSearch2/PMCopy2/PMManagers2/PMManagers2Data/PMShell2); no second state owner.

schema_event_storage_impacts.impact: Demo state persisted under PMState2 key pm.settings-demo2.concept-07-compendium-workspace; namespaced, no shared keys.

migration_supersession_impacts.impact: Honors machine_readable/supersessions.json (seven concepts; per-concept coverage; no editable scopes; rid-only search routing). Concepts 01-04 frozen, untouched.

slint_port_impacts: Web prototype maps to Slint 1.17.1 via stable model ids (category/subgroup/setting/rid), windowed virtual lists (PMManagers2.virtualList), hash-route state machines with narrow incremental re-render, bounded 2px blur on modal overlays only, and reduced-motion static states; no DOM-only core behavior.
